title: DrawingAnnotations
description: What is written on ONE drawing sheet: title-block fields, the legend, the drawing schedule, scale notes, and dimension or quantity annotations such as L=245.0m, D300 uPVC, 12 nos. Pure data: no action fields. Annotated values are READ from the sheet, never estimated or measured from the picture. Geometry measurement is done elsewhere, deterministically.

scale_notes.description: Scale statements printed on the sheet, verbatim.

legend.description: Legend entries: what each symbol, line style or hatch means, as printed.

symbol.description: Short description of the symbol or line style, e.g. dashed blue line.

label.description: The legend text, verbatim, e.g. Proposed 300mm uPVC sewer.

schedule.description: Rows of any drawing schedule or table on the sheet (manhole schedule, pipe schedule, bar schedule, drawing list), each row as its cell texts in order, verbatim.

annotations.description: Dimension or quantity annotations printed on the sheet.

text.description: The annotation exactly as printed, e.g. L=245.0m, D300 uPVC, 12 nos.

value.description: The printed numeric value (245.0 for L=245.0m). Null if there is none.

unit.description: The printed unit (m, m2, nos), null if none.

material.description: Material or size text attached to the annotation, e.g. uPVC SN8 D300.

bbox.description: Bounding box on the page image as [left, top, right, bottom], fractions 0..1 of page width/height. Null if unsure.
